texte: Hi William! 😊 Thank you for the like. I saw you're coming to Manila soon? Is it your first time here?
Yes it is my first time and I am looking for a guide too . Why not you haha
Hi William 🙂 Just got home from my shift, so tired 😅 Thanks for the like! "Let's meet in real life"… ok, but coffee first 😄 When will you be in Manila?
I arrive in Manila on Thursday.
Hello William 😊 I'm fine, thank you. Just got home from my duty at the hospital, so tired but thankful to God 🙏 How about you, how's your day? Are you already here in Manila?

I arrive in Manila on Thursday. Don't you have WhatsApp? It would be better, smoother to communicate. And I have to tell you: I've totally fallen for your charm. I want you to be the first person I see once I arrive in Manila.
Hi William! Sorry for the late reply, I was on shift and so tired 😅 I'm good, thanks! How about you? Where are you from?

No worries, I understand. I'm fine, thanks! I'm from Luxembourg. I arrive in Manila tomorrow and I would really love to meet you, so we can get to know each other. Maybe it's destiny. I have a good situation, even an excellent one. So why not change our lives, both of us?

Wow, tomorrow already? 😊 That's so sweet of you. Maybe it is destiny haha 🙏 I'd love to meet you too. Just so you know, I'm a single mom, I hope it's ok with you. I work night shift, but I'm free on Saturday. Where will you stay?
